types.name: applyTranslationsToTaxLines
types.description:
Applies translations to tax lines. If you are using a tax provider that doesn't have TaxRates defined in the database,
you should apply the translations inside of your tax provider's `getTaxLines` method, using the `locale` provided in the context.

types.name: applyTranslations
types.type: (`__namedParameters`: ``{ localeCode: undefined \| string ; objects: Record<string, any>[] ; container: [MedusaContainer](/references/medusa/types/medusa.MedusaContainer)  }``) => Promise<void>
